name: Gyakuten Majo Saiban -Chijo na Majo ni Sabakarechau-
original_name: 逆転魔女裁判 －痴女な魔女に裁かれちゃう－
source: Enma Kaoru, who conceals her identity as a descendant of witches, spends her days at school like a queen due to her beauty and ample bosom. One day, she mistakenly accuses a boy named Aiba Sakae of being a witch hunter from the church and ends up revealing her own identity as a witch. This leads Sakae to be involved in a event known as the Reversal Witch Trial, known for its unfair judgments. Sakae is scared by the situation, and Kaoru, stimulated by his vulnerability, decides to use the trial as an opportunity to turn him into her plaything...
translation: 艶间 薫隐藏着巫女后裔的身份，凭借美貌与丰满的胸部，在学校里过着女王般的生活。某天，她误将名为相羽 栄的男孩指认为教会派来的猎巫人，结果暴露了自己巫女的身份。栄因此被卷入以不公正裁决闻名的“逆转魔女审判”。栄被眼前的事态吓坏了，而薫受到他脆弱模样的刺激，决定利用这场审判把他变成自己的玩物……
